annotations.title: robots.txt & llms.txt AI Crawler Analyzer & Generator API

description: robots.txt & llms.txt AI Crawler Analyzer & Generator API: Audit which AI crawlers your robots.txt allows and generate a valid llms.txt file. (Endpoint: POST /v1/robots-llms-analyzer)

desired_ai_policy.description: Policy used to generate the recommended robots.txt AI crawler snippet.

llms_txt.description: Optional raw llms.txt content to validate against the llmstxt.org specification.
llms_txt.example:
# Tinplate Edge Micro-APIs

> Stateless security and developer micro-APIs on Cloudflare Workers.

## Documentation

- [Architecture](https://tinplate.dev/docs/architecture): Full technical reference
- [Privacy Notice](https://tinplate.dev/privacy): Zero payload logging policy

robots_txt.example:
User-agent: *
Allow: /

User-agent: GPTBot
Disallow: /

User-agent: CCBot
Disallow: /

Sitemap: https://tinplate.dev/sitemap.xml

site_info.description: Optional site metadata used to generate a valid llms.txt file.

test_path.description: URL path to test crawler permissions against (default '/').

name: tinplate_robots_llms_analyzer
